title: Detached focused launcher run: the 'unsupported form' notice arrives only after a 33-minute run completes, and doesn't say whether registered verification credit still follows
outcome:
Reported by Engram::Merger in TermAl mailbox 5cdad9a7 #567.

Reproduction:
- Named root: C:\github\Personal\Engram\.worktrees\postlanding-closure-bb89-b7b3-20261124.
- At 10:55:37Z on 2026-11-24, ran: `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --input commit --detach --item w-bb8937eae6e5 -- cargo test --lib`
- The launcher returned STARTED, run test-2e31088e-6a45-4037-8cc5-4c7ba835d3fa. It completed PASS, exit 0, at 11:28:59Z on commit b7b3ab8f, tree cf1fd0cd.
- Only AFTER completion did TermAl report: "Unsupported focused launcher form "...": --detach is not a foreground focused check; no Test or Build record will follow; use supported foreground launcher options."

Code and docs:
- The notice comes from turn-check recognition (src/engram_check_recognition.rs:610-611).
- docs/test.md:1438: "A focused run started with --detach is no test check at all: only a full gate is carried."
- Registered verification (verification_record, docs/test.md:1142-1148) is a separate path.

Open question, to be established first: did test-2e31088e earn a verification_record? The run was registered with --input commit in the named root.

Two problems either way:
(1) Timing: the form is known at launch, but the refusal is reported only after a 33-minute run. It should be reported at launch, before the run starts, or the launcher should refuse the form outright.
(2) Wording: "no Test or Build record will follow" doesn't say whether registered verification credit still follows. Agents read it as lost credit and rerun.

Wanted:
- Report the unsupported form at launch.
- Make the notice state plainly whether verification_record credit follows for that run.
- If detached focused registered runs are meant to earn no credit at all, say that in the launcher's refusal and in docs/test.md.
acceptance: Detached focused launcher run: the 'unsupported form' notice arrives only after a 33-minute run completes, and doesn't say whether registered verification credit still follows is done
